title: Worker Çıkarma Analizi
description: Hedef doluluk ve çıkarılacak node sayısına göre worker çıkarılıp çıkarılamayacağını gösterir.

list.name: target_cpu_req
list.label: Hedef CPU request (%)
list.description: Worker'larda izin verilen azami doluluk yüzdesi.

list.name: target_cpu_use
list.label: Hedef CPU kullanım (%)
list.description: Worker'larda izin verilen azami doluluk yüzdesi.

list.label: Hedef Memory request (%)

targets.expr: count(max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="$role"}))

panels.title: En fazla çıkarılabilir
panels.description: Tüm metrikler kendi hedef doluluğunun altında kalacak şekilde çıkarılabilecek en fazla node sayısı. 0 ise node çıkarılamaz.

targets.expr: clamp_min(min(label_replace(floor(count(max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="$role"})) - sum((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1)) * on (node) group_left () max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="$role"})) / (avg((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"}) * on (node) group_left () max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="$role"})) * $target_cpu_req / 100)), "kaynak", "CPU request", "", "") or label_replace(floor(count(max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="$role"})) - max_over_time(sum((label_replace(avg_over_time(instance:node_cpu:rate:sum[$step]), "node", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+).*")) * on (node) group_left () max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="$role"}))[$__range:$step]) / (avg((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"}) * on (node) group_left () max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="$role"})) * $target_cpu_use / 100)), "kaynak", "CPU kullanım (peak)", "", "") or label_replace(floor(count(max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="$role"})) - sum((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1)) * on (node) group_left () max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="$role"})) / (avg((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}) * on (node) group_left () max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="$role"})) * $target_mem_req / 100)), "kaynak", "Memory request", "", "") or label_replace(floor(count(max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="$role"})) - max_over_time(sum((label_replace(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes, "node", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+).*")) * on (node) group_left () max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="$role"}))[$__range:$step]) / (avg((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}) * on (node) group_left () max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="$role"})) * $target_mem_use / 100)), "kaynak", "Memory kullanım (peak)", "", "") or label_replace(floor(count(max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="$role"})) - count((kube_pod_info{node!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1)) * on (node) group_left () max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="$role"})) / (avg((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="pods"}) * on (node) group_left () max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="$role"})) * $target_pod / 100)), "kaynak", "Pod sayısı", "", "")), 0)
